# Wealth Tellers

> Wealth Tellers is a UAE business setup consultancy for founders establishing a company in Dubai and the wider United Arab Emirates. Clients can hold 100% of the business. Setup can be completed remotely, across more than 3,000 business activities.

## Key pages

- [Wealth Tellers](https://works.bishoyzaki.com/wealth-tellers/): Dubai and UAE business setup consultancy
- [Services](https://works.bishoyzaki.com/wealth-tellers/#services): Mainland, Free Zone, and Offshore company formation
- [Process](https://works.bishoyzaki.com/wealth-tellers/#process): Document preparation, approvals, residency support, and corporate banking
- [Packages](https://works.bishoyzaki.com/wealth-tellers/#packages): Standard package AED 4,888 and Golden package AED 10,800
- [Experts](https://works.bishoyzaki.com/wealth-tellers/#experts): Wealth Tellers advisors
- [FAQ](https://works.bishoyzaki.com/wealth-tellers/#faq): Company formation questions answered on the page
- [Contact](https://wealthtellers.com/contact-us/): Contact Wealth Tellers

## Packages

- Standard Package, AED 4,888: business license, virtual office, digital banking assistance, multiple shareholders, multiple business activities, a dedicated relationship manager, and free co-working access.
- Golden Package, AED 10,800: everything in Standard, plus one residency, a medical examination, and corporate tax registration.
